review.tagline: Agent Skills for Hugging Face Hub, training, evals and SageMaker deployment
review.summary: A collection of about 24 Agent Skills folders (SKILL.md plus scripts) that teach coding agents Hugging Face workflows: Hub CLI operations, TRL and Unsloth fine-tuning, evals, Spaces, Gradio, Trackio and SageMaker deployment. Claude Code and Cursor marketplaces expose only hf-cli; other skills install with `hf skills add <name>`. A Gemini CLI extension and a generated AGENTS.md fallback are included.
review.audience: Developers using coding agents with the Hugging Face Hub
strengths: Follows the Agent Skills format; works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor
hf-cli skill is generated from the locally installed CLI, so commands stay current
Covers datasets, training, evals, Spaces, papers and SageMaker deployment
AGENTS.md fallback bundle for agents without skill support
weaknesses: Client marketplaces list only hf-cli; other skills need the hf CLI to install
Codex install is a manual copy or symlink into .agents/skills
Training skills target Hugging Face Jobs, a hosted service
Some skills overlap, such as huggingface-llm-trainer and trl-training
needs: Needs hf CLI, Hugging Face Hub account, AWS account (SageMaker skills)
